messages:
anya: Tiny poll: whats everyones go-to 45-minute wind-down playlist for reading on the porch? No pop radio, please.
greg: for reading i always do lo-fi jazz -> ambient transition. Chet Baker if i want trumpet mood.
kevin: if it's a porch sunset, some Nick Drake mixed with mellow electronic does the trick.
mira: ooh Nick Drake + field recordings. also try 'Music for Airports' as a baseline.
anya: love the Nick Drake rec. anyone have a short audiobook/light read suggestion to pair? looking for something cozy, not heavy.
jukebox-bot: Quick match: "The Slow Regard of Silent Things" (short, quiet) + playlist "Evening Porch" https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2example :notes:
greg: perfect combo. that novella is like a slow cup of tea.
kevin: adding: album "The Campfire Headphase" by Boards of Canada for a warmer electronic texture.
mira: bookmarking all of these. we should swap mini-sets next week: 3 songs + a short reading. low friction.
anya: yes! tiny exchange. i'll start: Nick Drake (Pink Moon) 3 tracks, then a 20-min reading. sunday 7pm?
jukebox-bot: Event created: "Porch Mini-Set Swap" 1767890400 (Sun 7pm local).
kevin: RSVP: in. will craft a vinyl crackle set. :vhs:
greg: in too. thanks for elevating my evening, team.
anya: done. will DM the short reading choices before sunday.
